title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
description: Official 200-question Board Licensure Examination (Oct 18, 2021, Set B) covering Foods, Food Preparation, Food Microbiology, Management, Costing, and Meal Service.

cards.front: Garlic, onions and shallots are examples of ___.
cards.rationale: Garlic, onions, and shallots are bulbs (underground storage structures consisting of a stem surrounded by fleshy leaves). Sweet potato and cassava are examples of roots and tubers.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 1. Margin note: Sweet potato = roots & tubers.

cards.front: Overboiling of egg will result to ___.
cards.rationale: Excessive heat causes overcoagulation of egg white and yolk proteins, causing syneresis and the formation of a dark grayish-green ferrous sulfide ring at the yolk-white interface.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 2. Margin notes: Acrolein = overheating fat; Gelatinization = cereal/starch; Rancidity = spoilage in oil.

cards.front: What condition favors the growth of Clostridium botulinum?
cards.back: Absence of air and low acidic environment
cards.rationale: Clostridium botulinum is an obligate anaerobe that thrives in low-acid conditions (pH > 4.6) in the absence of oxygen, producing a potent neurotoxin.
options: Absence of air and low acidic environment
Presence of air and high acidic environment
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 3. Anaerobic, low-acid canning hazard.

cards.front: Which of the following milk products has the longest shelf life?
cards.rationale: Ultra-High Temperature (UHT) milk is commercially sterilized at 135–150°C and aseptically packaged, giving it a stable shelf life of 6 to 9 months at room temperature without refrigeration.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 4. UHT aseptic packaging guarantees longest commercial shelf life at ambient temperature.

cards.front: This food additive is added in salad dressings to allow smooth mixture of ingredients without separation. Examples of this additive are soy lecithin and egg yolks.
cards.rationale: Emulsifiers (like lecithin) possess both hydrophilic and lipophilic ends, stabilizing immiscible oil-and-water emulsions in dressings and sauces.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 5. Emulsifiers prevent oil and water separation.

cards.front: How do you ensure tenderness of a thick crust pizza?
cards.back: Apply oil or soft fats on the crust before cooking
cards.rationale: Applying fats or oil coats gluten strands and locks in internal dough moisture, ensuring the thick crust stays tender, pliable, and soft rather than excessively dry and brittle.
options: Lower the temperature and slow cook
Apply oil or soft fats on the crust before cooking
Add more vegetables as toppings after cooking
Add more pineapple as toppings during cooking
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 6. Fats shorten gluten strands to promote tenderness.

cards.front: If Ilocos has pinakbet, Central Visayas has ___.
cards.rationale: Utan Bisaya is the iconic indigenous vegetable soup of Central Visayas, equivalent to Northern Luzon's Pinakbet. (Paklay is an offal stew; Sinanglay is a Bicol dish).
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 7. Utan = Visayan vegetable soup; Sinanglay = Bicol.

cards.front: What will happen if warm foods are readily stored in the refrigerator?
cards.back: Temperature of the ref will rise
cards.rationale: Warm foods emit heat that overtaxes the cooling unit and raises internal refrigerator temperature above 4°C (40°F), placing nearby items into the Temperature Danger Zone.
options: Dry food items in the ref will have moist
Temperature of the ref will rise
Other foods in the ref will get spoiled
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 8. Direct thermodynamic effect = ref temperature rises.

cards.front: Sasa is setting up a food business in her province. She is applying for her business permit in the municipal office. In order to fast track release of her business certificate, she offered to give Php 10,000 to one staff in the office. This incident is an example of ___.
cards.rationale: Bribery is the direct offering or giving of money or anything of value to influence a public official or employee in the performance of official duties.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 9. Code of Ethics and legal definitions.

cards.front: Where is the best location of a school cafeteria?
cards.rationale: A first/ground floor location ensures straightforward access for heavy delivery trucks, direct receiving dock connection, efficient trash removal, and safe, barrier-free student access.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 10. Facility layout and receiving logistics.

cards.front: A 550g organic kale costs Php300 per kg. The edible portion is 70%. What is the EP price of organic kale per kg?
cards.rationale: For 550g purchased at Php300/kg, AP cost = 0.550 kg × Php300 = Php165. The purchased cost of the 550g bunch is Php 165.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 11. Margin calculation: 550g / 1000g × 300 = Php 165.

cards.front: Which is NOT correct in arranging food on a plate?
cards.rationale: Overloading a plate creates an unappealing, messy appearance; aesthetic plating requires balance, focal points, and adequate rim space.
options: Rims must be free from drips.
Sauce is poured over the meat or served separately in a sauceboat.
Hot food should always served on a hot plate.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 12. Principles of aesthetic food presentation.

cards.front: Process of assigning job activities and authority to a specific employee within the organization:
cards.rationale: Delegation is the process of assigning responsibility and necessary authority to subordinates to accomplish designated tasks.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 13. Management principles.

cards.front: Meat of a mature sheep is ___.
cards.rationale: Mutton is the meat of adult sheep (older than 1 year). Lamb is from sheep under 1 year, and veal is from young calves.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 14. Meat classification.

cards.front: What do you call a white flour resulting from removal of at least 25% of the bran and shorts during milling?
cards.rationale: Refined white flour is produced after milling away the protective bran and germ fractions (at least 25% of the grain), leaving pure starchy endosperm.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 15. Cereal milling standards.

cards.front: Anthocyanins: ___; Anthonxanthins: ___.
cards.rationale: Anthocyanins produce red, purple, and blue pigments (e.g., berries, red cabbage), while anthoxanthins produce white, ivory, and light yellow pigments (e.g., cauliflower, potato).
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 16. Plant pigments: Anthocyanin = red; Anthoxanthin = white/cream.

cards.front: Cinnamon is from ___.
cards.rationale: Cinnamon is harvested from the inner dried bark of Cinnamomum trees (such as Cinnamomum zeylanicum or verum).
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 17. Botanical source: Sri Lankan cinnamon tree bark.

cards.front: The "A" in FATTOM, an acronym used to describe the conditions in microbial growth, means ___.
cards.rationale: FATTOM: Food, Acidity (pH 4.6–7.5), Time, Temperature (4°C–60°C), Oxygen, and Moisture (Aw ≥ 0.85).
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 18. FATTOM conditions for bacterial growth.

cards.front: These are non-digestible food substances that stimulate the growth of good bacteria in the gut.
cards.rationale: Prebiotics are non-digestible dietary fibers (e.g., fructooligosaccharides, inulin) that nourish and stimulate the proliferation of beneficial probiotic bacteria.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 19. Prebiotics = non-digestible fiber food for bacteria; Probiotics = live beneficial organisms.

cards.front: It is an organism able to grow at high temperature.
cards.rationale: Thermophiles thrive in hot temperatures, typically between 45°C and 80°C (113°F–176°F). Psychrotrophs grow at cold temperatures (0°C–7°C).
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 20. Microbial temperature classifications.

cards.front: This occurs during the first five minutes of baking due to the acceleration of fermentation due to the heat, causing the rise of the dough.
cards.rationale: Oven spring is the sudden rapid expansion of dough during early baking, driven by thermal expansion of trapped carbon dioxide and accelerated yeast activity before thermal death.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 21. Baking dynamics.

cards.front: Identify the dishes which are popular in Mindanao Region.
cards.rationale: Bas-uy (liver soup), Linat-an (boiled pork bone soup), and Paklay (spiced pork/beef innards) are widely known regional specialties of Mindanao and Central/Southern Visayas.
options: Sinigang na Kanduli, Sisig and Bringhe
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 22. Philippine regional cuisine mapping.

cards.front: Food is hot filled into the container then sealed under aseptic conditions and processed immediately is called ___.
cards.rationale: In the hot pack method, heated food is packed hot into jars or cans, driving out air and ensuring quicker heat penetration during final canning/retort processing.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 23. Canning methods: Hot pack vs Raw/Cold pack.

cards.front: The browning of baked products is due to ___.
cards.rationale: Maillard browning occurs when amino acids and reducing sugars interact under dry heat, creating golden-brown pigments (melanoidins) and pleasant roasted flavors.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 24. Non-enzymatic browning.

cards.front: What is a right of employees concerning vacation leaves, working hours and holidays?
cards.rationale: Under the Labor Code of the Philippines, employees have statutory entitlements to proper payment for work performed, statutory holiday premiums, and approved service incentive leaves.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 25. Labor law rights.

cards.front: Which government agency is responsible in licensing, monitoring, and regulating the food products being sold in the market?
cards.rationale: The Food and Drug Administration (FDA) of the Philippines regulates and licenses processed foods, drugs, and cosmetics under Republic Act No. 9711.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 26. Regulatory agencies: FDA.

cards.front: Which is a type of food spoilage that includes enzymatic reactions in living things as influenced by temperature, moisture, pH and the nutrients present?
cards.rationale: Biochemical spoilage (autolysis) involves the action of natural enzymes already present within animal or plant tissues after harvest or slaughter.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 27. Food deterioration types: biochemical / autolysis.

cards.front: The labor cost for a certain dish is Php20 per hour. If it takes 45 minutes to make the dish, what is the labor cost for this particular dish?
cards.rationale: Labor cost = Hourly rate × (45 / 60 hours) = Php 20 × 0.75 = Php 15.00.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 28. Margin formula: 20 × (45/60) = 15.

cards.front: The enzyme which is important for cheese production is ___.
cards.rationale: Renin (chymosin / rennet) hydrolyzes the Phe105-Met106 peptide bond in kappa-casein, causing milk proteins to coagulate into curd.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 29. Cheese making enzymes: Renin / Chymosin.

cards.front: The softest cheese among the following is ___.
cards.rationale: Brie is a soft-ripened cheese containing over 50% moisture, making it much softer than semi-hard (Gouda, Edam) and hard (Cheddar) cheeses.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 30. Cheese moisture classifications: Brie is soft cheese.

cards.front: Choose a form of disaccharide usually used in the production of beer.
cards.rationale: Maltose (malt sugar, consisting of two alpha-D-glucose molecules) is generated during the malting and mashing of barley grains and is fermented by yeast into ethanol in brewing.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 31. Beer fermentation: Maltose from malted barley.

cards.front: Essential amino acids are ___.
cards.rationale: The 9 essential amino acids that must be supplied by diet are Histidine, Isoleucine, Leucine, Lysine, Methionine, Phenylalanine, Threonine, Tryptophan, and Valine (mnemonic: PVT TIM HLL).
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 32. Mnemonic: PVT TIM HLL.

cards.front: Which is NOT true about Churros?
cards.rationale: Churros are piped choux-like dough that is deep-fried (not baked) in hot oil and traditionally served dusted with sugar/cinnamon alongside thick hot dipping chocolate.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 33. Deep-fried choux dough from Spain.

cards.front: During a review of customer feedback survey, Michelle, RND, noted a pattern of dissatisfaction with the consistency of the quality of the beef caldereta. The most likely cause for the problem would be ___.
cards.back: the quality of the beef used not consistent with the specifications.
cards.rationale: Inconsistent meat cuts, connective tissue tenderness, and fat marbling from unstandardized purchasing specifications cause variable meat texture and toughness across batches.
options: diners are unaware of the true taste of beef caldereta.
the quality of the beef used not consistent with the specifications.
the waiters are not using the appropriate size dishes when plating the dish
the cooks are not using the standardized recipe.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 34. Quality control and purchasing specifications.

cards.front: What dish can be made to utilize leftover steamed kangkong from the last family dinner?
cards.rationale: Utan (Visayan vegetable soup) readily incorporates leftover steamed leafy greens like kangkong. Baye-baye is a sweet rice delicacy; dinakdakan and sisig are grilled pork offal dishes.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 35. Menu planning and leftovers utilization.

cards.front: The "F" in FATTOM, an acronym used to describe the conditions in microbial growth, means ___.
cards.rationale: The 'F' in FATTOM stands for Food (specifically nutrients like proteins and carbohydrates that bacteria feed on).
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 36. FATTOM conditions.

cards.front: Which kind of damage results from dehydration of a frozen breaded chicken patty due to extreme cold?
cards.rationale: Freezer burn is the dehydration and oxidation that occurs when frozen food is improperly wrapped, causing moisture sublimation and dry, bleached, spongy surfaces.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 37. Sublimation in frozen storage.

cards.front: How do you call the bacteria which can be found in powdered infant formula which can cause meningitis?
cards.rationale: Enterobacter sakazakii (now Cronobacter sakazakii) is a pathogen known to contaminate powdered infant formula, causing severe neonatal necrotizing enterocolitis, sepsis, and meningitis.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 38. Cronobacter / Enterobacter sakazakii infant hazard.

cards.front: What will happen to sugar if it is heated above 160 degrees C?
cards.rationale: Caramelization is the thermal decomposition of sucrose and other carbohydrates when dry heated to around 160°C–180°C, producing golden-brown color and buttery nutty flavors.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 39. Thermal breakdown of sugar = Caramelization.

cards.front: Which department is NOT involved in the receiving process in hospital's foodservice?
cards.rationale: Receiving involves the Dietary department (inspecting specifications), Purchasing (matching purchase orders), and Accounting (invoice/invoice tracking). Human Resources manages personnel, not daily delivery logistics.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 40. Foodservice department roles in receiving.

cards.front: The muscle pigment is called ___.
cards.rationale: Myoglobin is the primary iron- and oxygen-binding hemoprotein found in skeletal muscle tissues responsible for meat color. Hemoglobin is in red blood cells.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 41. Muscle pigment = Myoglobin.

cards.front: Select the BEST way to manage leftovers from the morning buffet at the hotel.
cards.back: Sell leftovers at the employees' cafeteria at low cost
cards.rationale: Selling wholesome surplus buffet foods immediately in the employee cafeteria at subsidized rates recovers costs safely while avoiding customer food-safety liabilities of re-serving on buffets.
options: Serve the same food to the diners for lunch and dinner
Sell leftovers at the employees' cafeteria at low cost
Freeze the leftover and serve the following day
Let the employees take out all the leftovers everyday
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 42. Hotel buffet leftover management protocols.

cards.front: Which is true about passing the licensure examination for ND based on the ND law in 2016?
cards.back: Must have a general average of 75% with no rating below 50% in any subjects
cards.rationale: Under Republic Act No. 10862 (Nutrition and Dietetics Law of 2016), a candidate must obtain a General Weighted Average of at least 75%, with no grade below 50% in any given examination subject.
options: Must have a general average of 70% with no rating below 70% in any subjects
Must have a general average of 75% with no rating below 70% in any subjects
Must obtain at least 80% general average in all of the subjects
Must have a general average of 75% with no rating below 50% in any subjects
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 43. RA 10862 passing criteria: GWA >= 75%, no sub < 50%.

cards.front: Identify the thread-like noodles which made from cassava and wheat flour.
cards.rationale: Miswa is an extremely thin, thread-like salted Chinese-style noodle made from wheat flour and cassava/corn starch. (Sotanghon is made from mung bean starch; Canton is egg noodle).
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 44. Miswa = thread-like wheat/cassava noodles.

cards.front: Lutong Bahay canteen is operating in Makati. All the food preparation is done in the area. It also accommodates short orders like pancit and tapsilog. This foodservice system is ___.
cards.rationale: In a conventional foodservice system, ingredients are assembled and all food preparation and cooking are performed on-site immediately prior to service or short-order preparation.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 45. Foodservice systems: Conventional = cook and serve on premises.

cards.front: Which of the following foods are responsible for most allergic reactions?
cards.rationale: The 'Big 8' major food allergens responsible for over 90% of allergic reactions include milk, eggs, peanuts, tree nuts, wheat, soy, fish, and crustacean shellfish.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 46. Major food allergens (Big 8).

cards.front: What is the most cost-efficient way of scouting for an applicant for a mid-level to high-level position?
cards.rationale: LinkedIn provides targeted professional searches, resume viewing, and credential verification at lower cost and higher precision than general newspapers or broad job fairs.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 47. Recruitment methods for management.

cards.front: Laing and Binagol are both dishes made from gabi leaves and coconut milk. Laing is a dish from Bicol while Binagol is from ___.
cards.rationale: Binagol is a sweet regional delicacy of Eastern Visayas (Leyte and Samar) made from mashed taro (talyan/gabi), coconut milk, condensed milk, and sugar packed into a coconut shell (bagol).
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 48. Binagol = Leyte/Samar (Eastern Visayas).

cards.front: Which is NOT a characteristic of a fresh egg?
cards.rationale: Eggshells naturally have 7,000 to 17,000 tiny porous openings that allow respiratory gas and moisture exchange; an 'unporous shell' does not exist in nature.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 49. Fresh egg quality: shells are always porous.

cards.front: How many pints are there in 1 quart?
cards.rationale: Standard culinary volume conversions: 1 quart = 2 pints = 4 cups = 32 fluid ounces.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 50. 1 quart = 2 pints.

cards.front: The three categories of food contaminants are best described as:
cards.rationale: Standard HACCP and food safety classification groups all contaminants into Biological hazards (microorganisms), Chemical hazards (cleaning chemicals, toxins), and Physical hazards (glass, metal, bones).
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 51. Three HACCP hazard pillars.

cards.front: Substances in plant-based foods with physiologically active compounds that have functional benefits are called ___.
cards.rationale: Phytochemicals are naturally occurring biologically active chemical compounds found in plants (e.g., polyphenols, carotenoids, flavonoids) that provide health benefits and disease protection.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 52. Plant bioactives = Phytochemicals.

cards.front: The mother sauce of all white sauces is called ___.
cards.rationale: Bechamel is one of the classic French grand mother sauces made by thickening warm milk with a white roux (equal parts butter and flour). Espagnole is brown sauce.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 53. Classic French mother sauces: Bechamel = white sauce.

cards.front: This is a paste that is used to make hummus.
cards.rationale: Tahini is a smooth, rich paste made from toasted ground sesame seeds, a mandatory base ingredient blended with chickpeas, lemon, and garlic to make authentic hummus.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 54. Tahini = sesame paste.

cards.front: Oxidative rancidity happens in foods that have ___.
cards.rationale: Oxidative rancidity occurs when oxygen attacks double bonds of unsaturated fatty acids (polyunsaturated fats), forming lipid hydroperoxides that break down into foul-smelling aldehydes and ketones.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 55. Oxidation targets unsaturated double bonds.

cards.front: When one person or department purchases for every department, it is called ___.
cards.rationale: Centralized purchasing designates a single purchasing manager or procurement department to handle all purchasing across every department in the organization, maximizing volume discounts.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 56. Centralized purchasing structure.

cards.front: If you open sealed bids and place the order with the lowest bid, you are using which buying method?
cards.rationale: Competitive formal bidding requires vendors to submit sealed quotations based on tight specifications, which are opened publicly at a designated date to select the lowest qualified bidder.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 57. Purchasing methods: Competitive sealed bidding.

cards.front: Which of the following factors would be MOST important to determine the food cost per serving for fruits and vegetables?
cards.rationale: Fruits and vegetables produce variable trim, peeling, and seed losses. The Edible Portion (EP) weight and EP yield percentage determine the true raw ingredient cost per portion.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 58. Edible Portion (EP) determines true serving cost.

cards.front: Rigor mortis is an example of ___ spoilage.
cards.rationale: Rigor mortis is an endogenous biochemical process resulting from post-mortem anaerobic glycolysis, lactic acid buildup, ATP depletion, and irreversible actin-myosin cross-linking.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 59. Post-mortem biochemical muscle changes.

cards.front: A cold soup in Spanish cuisine which contains cucumber, peppers, tomatoes, oils, vinegar, and bread:
cards.rationale: Gazpacho is an Andalusian Spanish cold soup made of blended raw ripe tomatoes, sweet bell peppers, cucumber, garlic, stale bread, olive oil, and sherry vinegar.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 60. Gazpacho = cold Spanish tomato-cucumber soup.

cards.front: Aspergillus niger: ___; Sarcina lutea: ___.
cards.rationale: Aspergillus niger produces characteristic black mold colonies, while Sarcina lutea (Micrococcus luteus) produces bright yellow pigment colonies.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 61. Microbial pigmentation: A. niger = black; S. lutea = yellow.

cards.front: What will you add to marshmallow to retain the moisture?
cards.rationale: Humectants (such as sorbitol, glycerol, or invert sugar) are hygroscopic substances incorporated into confections to bind water and retain moisture, preventing staling and drying.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 62. Humectants retain moisture in confections.

cards.front: Which of the following is NOT a beef?
cards.rationale: Game refers to hunted wild birds or non-domesticated mammals (like venison, pheasant, wild boar). Cow, heifer, and stag are bovine cattle classes.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 63. Bovine classifications vs Game.

cards.front: Which is the second step in undertaking a research study in Foodservice?
cards.rationale: In standard research methodology: Step 1 is selecting/determining the research topic, followed immediately by Step 2: identifying the problem and stating specific goals and objectives.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 64. Research steps: 1=topic, 2=goals/objectives.

cards.front: Foods that are decomposed or produced in unsanitary conditions are considered ___.
cards.rationale: Under the Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act, a food is deemed 'adulterated' if it consists in whole or in part of any filthy, putrid, or decomposed substance, or if it was prepared under unsanitary conditions.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 65. Legal definition of Adulterated Food.

cards.front: A bacon spread has a serving size of 30 g. What is the equivalent household measurement?
cards.rationale: In standard Philippine dietary food exchange lists and household measurements, 1 tablespoon of semi-solid spread or condiment is approximately 15 grams; hence 30 grams = 2 tablespoons.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 66. 1 tbsp = 15g; 2 tbsp = 30g.

cards.front: If the original yield of a macaroni salad recipe is 2.5 kg and you need only 1.5 kg to serve your guests, what will be the conversion factor of each ingredient to be used in the recipe?
cards.rationale: Recipe Conversion Factor (RCF) = Desired Yield ÷ Original Yield = 1.5 kg ÷ 2.5 kg = 0.60.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 67. Margin calculation: 1.5 / 2.5 = 0.60.

cards.front: This is NOT a sandwich.
cards.rationale: Creole refers to a regional cultural style of cuisine originating in Louisiana. Canape (open-faced), Clubhouse (multi-decker), and Banh Mi (Vietnamese baguette) are all distinct sandwiches.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 68. Sandwich taxonomy.

cards.front: Samgyeopsal in Korea basically refers to ___.
cards.rationale: Samgyeopsal literally translates to 'three-layered meat' in Korean, specifically referring to thick slices of pork belly cooked on a tabletop grill.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 69. Korean culinary terminology.

cards.front: The cause of an outbreak of a foodborne illness was traced to unpasteurized milk; symptoms included fever, nausea, headache. The likely source is ___.
cards.rationale: Listeria monocytogenes is a psychrotrophic pathogen commonly transmitted via raw, unpasteurized milk and soft cheeses, causing listeriosis with fever, headaches, and bacteremia.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 70. Unpasteurized dairy hazard = Listeria monocytogenes.

cards.front: Which statement is TRUE about incomplete protein?
cards.back: Incomplete protein will support maintenance but not growth
cards.rationale: Incomplete proteins lack one or more essential amino acids in sufficient amounts; they can sustain tissue maintenance and turnover, but cannot support cellular growth and repair on their own.
options: Both animal meat and plants contain incomplete protein
Incomplete protein will support both maintenance and growth
Incomplete protein will support maintenance but not growth
Animal meat is a source of incomplete protein
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 71. Protein quality and biological value.

cards.front: Gabriel was invited to attend See Wong's birthday party in a restaurant which serves international cuisines. Identify the country of origin of Canape (small open-faced sandwich on toast):
cards.rationale: Canape is a classic French hors d'oeuvre consisting of a small, decorative base of bread or toast topped with savory spreads and garnishes.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 72. French culinary terms.

cards.front: Which is the PRIMARY cause of food borne illness?
cards.rationale: Bacteria (such as Salmonella, Campylobacter, S. aureus, and E. coli) are the leading cause of bacterial foodborne intoxications and infections worldwide.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 73. Primary cause of foodborne illness.

cards.front: Acidic food: ___; Non-acidic food: ___.
cards.rationale: Pickles have high acetic acid content (pH < 4.6, acidic), whereas fresh coconut (buko) water is near neutral (pH 5.5–6.2, low-acid / non-acidic).
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 74. Food pH classifications.

cards.front: In food preservation, the main goal is to lengthen generation time of microorganisms and as much as possible to lengthen lag phase and phase of positive acceleration. Choose one of the ways this can be done:
cards.rationale: Low temperature refrigeration and chilling slows down microbial enzymatic activity, prolonging the lag phase and increasing bacterial generation doubling time.
options: Preserving the microorganisms to lengthen expiry date
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 75. Preservative mechanisms of chilling.

cards.front: Identify the bacteria which can be found in rice and other starchy foods.
cards.rationale: Bacillus cereus spore-formers survive boiling and produce an emetic toxin (cereulide) when cooked rice or starchy foods are left at room temperature (Fried Rice Syndrome).
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 76. Fried rice syndrome = Bacillus cereus.

cards.front: Which is the appropriate description of a functional food?
cards.back: It provides health benefits beyond basic nutrition
cards.rationale: Functional foods are defined as whole, fortified, enriched, or enhanced foods that provide documented physiological health benefits or reduce disease risk beyond providing basic nutritional requirements.
options: It stimulates growth of good bacteria in the gut.
It should be taken when a patient is under medication.
It is packed with vitamins and minerals.
It provides health benefits beyond basic nutrition
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 77. Definition of Functional Food.

cards.front: What is the effect of adding alcohol in cheese while cooking?
cards.rationale: In cheese preparations (such as Swiss fondue made with white wine/kirsch), the alcohol and tartaric acid lower the boiling point and blend with proteins to prevent tough, stringy curdling from overheating.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 78. Culinary chemistry of cheese cookery.

cards.front: What is the smoke point temperature for fats?
cards.rationale: Deep frying fats should possess a high smoke point, typically starting above 350°F (177°C) to 400°F (204°C), before glycerol decomposes into irritating acrolein fumes.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 79. Frying fats smoke point threshold.

cards.front: Which is the most flavorful part of pork due to the layers of fats in between muscles?
cards.rationale: Pork belly (liempo) features distinct alternating layers of intramuscular fat (marbling) and muscle tissue, making it the most succulent and flavorful cut.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 80. Liempo / Pork belly fat layers.

cards.front: Which is NOT a required benefit of an employee?
cards.rationale: Midyear bonus is a discretionary company perk unless stipulated in a Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA). 13th-month pay, statutory SSS/PhilHealth/Pag-IBIG, and 5 days Service Incentive Leave are mandatory by Philippine law.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 81. Philippine Labor law benefits.

cards.front: How do you call the poisonous toxins which can be found in peanut, tree nuts, corn and copra?
cards.rationale: Aflatoxins are potent hepatocarcinogenic mycotoxins produced by the molds Aspergillus flavus and Aspergillus parasiticus, frequently contaminating improperly dried peanuts, corn, and copra.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 82. Mycotoxins in peanuts/corn = Aflatoxins.

cards.front: Which is the commission that formulates internationally accepted food safety standards to protect the public and ensure fair trade practices?
cards.rationale: The Codex Alimentarius Commission (CAC), established jointly by FAO and WHO, establishes international food codes, standards, and guidelines for consumer health protection and fair food trade.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 83. International food standards body.

cards.front: If a broiler is 7-12-week-old chicken, fryer is ___.
cards.rationale: In poultry market classification, broilers are young tender birds (under 12 weeks), fryers are slightly older (14–20 weeks), and roasters are typically 5–10 months old.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 84. Poultry age classes.

cards.front: Which additive would add sweetness, act as a stabilizer and thickener, and retain moistness in a muffin?
cards.rationale: Sorbitol is a polyol (sugar alcohol) that imparts sweetness, functions as a humectant to retain moisture, and increases batter viscosity without crystallizing.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 85. Sorbitol functions as humectant & polyol.

cards.front: Being non-flammable, asbestos is good for ___.
cards.rationale: Due to its high heat resistance and non-combustible properties, asbestos was historically used as an industrial building and roofing fireproofing material.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 86. Fireproofing material = roofing.

cards.front: Which countries are known for pastries?
cards.rationale: Scandinavian countries (Denmark, Sweden, Norway) are world-renowned for their laminated yeast dough pastries (such as Danish pastries / wienerbrød).
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 87. Pastry origins: Danish / Scandinavian.

cards.front: Which costs will most likely be evaluated first after a budget reduction announcement?
cards.rationale: Labor is the largest controllable operational expense in foodservice (often 30–40% of total revenue); when budget reductions occur, management evaluates scheduling and overtime first.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 88. Controllable cost management.

cards.front: Which of the following are conjugated proteins?
cards.rationale: Conjugated proteins consist of simple amino acid chains combined with a non-protein prosthetic group (e.g., nucleic acids in nucleoproteins, carbohydrates in mucoproteins, lipids in lipoproteins).
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 89. Protein classification: Conjugated proteins.

cards.front: Which milk has almost all of its fat removed?
cards.rationale: Skim milk (non-fat milk) has had virtually all milkfat removed via centrifugal separation, containing less than 0.5% (typically < 0.1%) butterfat.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 90. Milk processing: Skim = non-fat.

cards.front: What organisms can cause spoilage to food inside the refrigerator?
cards.rationale: Psychrotrophs (such as Pseudomonas, Listeria, and molds) are cold-tolerant organisms capable of proliferating at refrigeration temperatures (0°C–7°C).
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 91. Refrigerated spoilage organisms.

cards.front: Chicken curry is NOT a popular dish in ___.
cards.rationale: Curry is a foundational staple dish across South and Southeast Asia (India, Thailand, Indonesia). While Germany has currywurst (sausage with spiced ketchup), chicken curry is not traditional German cuisine.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 92. International culinary traditions.

cards.front: Why are molds not the common microorganisms in heated canned products?
cards.rationale: Molds and their vegetative spores are heat-sensitive and are rapidly inactivated at temperatures well below standard thermal canning regimes (60°C–80°C).
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 93. Thermal death of molds in canning.

cards.front: Lycopene: ___; Carotene: ___.
cards.rationale: Lycopene is the primary red carotenoid found in tomatoes, watermelon, and pink guava; beta-carotene is the prominent orange carotenoid in carrots, pumpkins, and sweet potatoes.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 94. Plant pigments: Lycopene = tomato; Carotene = carrot.

cards.front: All the items below are suitable for freezing EXCEPT:
cards.rationale: Mayonnaise is a delicate emulsion of oil in water stabilized by egg yolk; freezing crystallizes water and causes emulsion breakdown, resulting in unpalatable oil separation.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 95. Emulsion breakdown during freezing.

cards.front: Large group of people experience acute gastroenteritis 4 to 6 hours after eating custard pie. Which bacteria are MOST likely the culprit?
cards.rationale: Staphylococcus aureus produces heat-stable enterotoxins in high-protein, creamy foods (like custards and cream pastries). It has a uniquely rapid incubation period of 1 to 6 hours causing sudden vomiting and diarrhea.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 96. Rapid 1-6 hr incubation in custards = S. aureus.

cards.front: Identify the people/populations that experience the most serious consequences of foodborne illnesses.
cards.rationale: Individuals with compromised immune systems (chemotherapy patients, organ transplant recipients, HIV/AIDS) have diminished cellular defense mechanisms and experience the highest rates of systemic bacteremia and mortality.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 97. High-risk populations.

cards.front: What do you call the noodles in Thailand?
cards.rationale: Pad Thai is Thailand's national stir-fried rice noodle dish. Bibimbap, Bulgogi, and Japchae are iconic dishes of South Korea.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 98. Thai cuisine.

cards.front: A management function that involves developing mission statements, setting goals and outlining steps needed to meet those goals:
cards.rationale: Planning is the primary foundational management function that defines organizational objectives, visions, strategies, and blueprints for achieving desired outcomes.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 99. Foundational management functions: Planning.

cards.front: Identify a wild berry which can be found in the Philippines.
cards.rationale: Mulberries (genus Morus) and Philippine wild raspberries (sampinit / Rubus rosifolius) grow readily in the Philippine highlands. Acai and Maqui are South American; Atis is a sugar apple (custard fruit).
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 100. Local berry flora: Mulberry / Sampinit.

cards.front: The desirable pink color in cured meat is due to:
cards.rationale: When nitrite is added to curing brine, it converts to nitric oxide and binds to reduced myoglobin to form nitrosomyoglobin, which converts into stable pink nitrosohemochrome upon heating.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 101. Cured meat pigment = Nitrosomyoglobin.

cards.front: Difference between the cost and the selling price:
cards.rationale: Markup is the amount or percentage added to the total product cost to establish the retail selling price (Selling Price − Cost = Markup).
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 102. Pricing formulas: Cost + Markup = Selling Price.

cards.front: Philippines: rice; Saudi Arabia: ___.
cards.rationale: Rice is the primary staple grain in the Philippines; spiced rice pilaf (Kabsa / Majboos pilaf) is the premier traditional grain staple of Saudi Arabia and the Arabian Peninsula.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 103. Middle Eastern staple grain dish = Pilaf.

cards.front: Overcooking or overheating of oil can cause ___.
cards.rationale: When frying oil is heated past its smoke point, triglycerides hydrolyze into free glycerol, which dehydrates into acrolein—a pungent, acrid, eye-irritating aldehyde vapor.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 104. Thermal breakdown of fat = Acrolein.

cards.front: To avoid foods spoiling in the refrigerator or freezer, which of the following actions is always recommended?
cards.back: Placing a date of arrival on all foods
cards.rationale: Clear labeling with arrival/preparation dates and expiration dates is the core operational prerequisite for executing FIFO (First-In, First-Out) inventory rotation.
options: Smelling the food to make sure it is fresh
Placing a date of arrival on all foods
Ordering foods for a few days at a time only
Placing the oldest product on top of newer product
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 105. Inventory control: FIFO date labeling.

cards.front: 1 cup fresh milk: ___; 1 cup of low fat milk: ___.
cards.rationale: Under the Philippine Food Exchange Lists (PEL): 1 exchange of Whole Milk provides 12g CHO, 8g PRO, 10g FAT = 170 kcal; Low Fat Milk provides 12g CHO, 8g PRO, 5g FAT = 125 kcal.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 106. PEL values: Whole milk = 170 kcal, Low fat = 125 kcal.

cards.front: Identify the ESSENTIAL amino acids.
cards.rationale: Threonine, Tryptophan, and Valine are essential amino acids that humans cannot synthesize de novo. Alanine, aspartic acid, and proline are non-essential.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 107. Essential amino acid list.

cards.front: Broken mayonnaise is due to ___.
cards.rationale: Mayonnaise requires oil to be incorporated drop by drop initially into the egg yolk emulsion; pouring oil too rapidly overwhelms the lecithin interfacial tension and causes phase separation (broken sauce).
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 108. Emulsion failure: Rapid oil addition.

cards.front: Beth is a graduate of BS Nursing in one province in the Philippines. She was appointed by the City Mayor to occupy the position of a Nutritionist-Dietitian in an LGU. As there is an ND Law, what should the mayor do?
cards.back: Comply with the law and replace Beth's position with an RND
cards.rationale: Republic Act No. 10862 strictly mandates that only Registered Nutritionist-Dietitians (RND) holding valid Professional Identification Cards issued by the PRC can hold Nutritionist-Dietitian plantillas.
options: Give a copy of the ND law to Beth and let her decide
Wait until Beth resigns or retires and get an RND
Ask the HR in the city health office to explain the law to Beth
Comply with the law and replace Beth's position with an RND
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 109. RA 10862 legal staffing mandate.

cards.front: Eggs can be stored at room temperature up to ___.
cards.rationale: At ambient tropical room temperature (25°C–30°C), table eggs deteriorate rapidly and maintain acceptable culinary and microbiological freshness for a maximum of 7 days before significant quality loss.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 110. Egg shelf-life at room temp = 7 days.

cards.front: Which food processing method has been linked to cancer in laboratory animals?
cards.rationale: Traditional wood smoke curing deposits polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs), such as benzo[a]pyrene, which are well-documented carcinogens and mutagens.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 111. Smoke curing PAH carcinogens.

cards.front: Which of the list below is a soluble fiber?
cards.rationale: Pectin is a water-soluble dietary fiber found in plant cell walls and intercellular cement that forms viscous gels. Cellulose, hemicellulose, and lignin are insoluble fibers.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 112. Dietary fiber classification: Pectin is soluble.

cards.front: Gluten can be extracted from dough made from flour and water by ___.
cards.rationale: Washing and kneading dough under a gentle stream of cold water washes away water-soluble starches and albumins, leaving an elastic, cohesive mass of gluten (gliadin and glutenin).
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 113. Gluten extraction by water washing.

cards.front: All the following foods are good sources of niacin EXCEPT ___.
cards.rationale: Tuna, chicken breast, and mushrooms are rich sources of preformed niacin. A baked potato provides small amounts of niacin but is primarily a carbohydrate staple.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 114. Niacin sources.

cards.front: Which is the size of a placeplate (charger plate)?
cards.rationale: A standard placeplate (service charger plate) measures 11 to 12 inches in diameter. Dinner plates are 10 inches, salad/soup plates 8–9 inches, and bread-and-butter plates 6 inches.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 115. Table setting chinaware dimensions: Placeplate = 12".

cards.front: A leadership style that requires that decisions are made by a group and is based on all members working together until an agreement is met:
cards.rationale: Consensus leadership involves collaborative problem-solving where all group members voice concerns and negotiate until a collective agreement supported by all is reached.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 116. Leadership styles: Consensus.

cards.front: Which of the following does NOT influence cooking time of meat?
cards.rationale: Standard culinary theory emphasizes that cooking method/temperature, thickness/cut size, and meat connective tissue density directly determine cooking duration.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 117. Meat cookery parameters.

cards.front: According to the ND Law, all successful candidates in the licensure examination shall ___ prior to the practice of nutrition and dietetics.
cards.rationale: Under RA 10862, all successful board examinees are legally required to take the professional oath before the PRC Board of Nutrition and Dietetics prior to entering professional practice.
options: Apply for Phil health and SSS
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 118. RA 10862 oath of profession.

cards.front: The government agency with the primary responsibility of ensuring the food safety of consumers:
cards.rationale: Under the Food Safety Act of 2013 (RA 10611), the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) of the Department of Health is responsible for the safety of processed and prepackaged food products.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 119. Primary agency for processed food safety = FDA.

cards.front: The following activities require temperature control EXCEPT ___.
cards.rationale: Storage, thawing, cooking, holding, and receiving are physical critical control points requiring strict thermometer verification. Menu planning is an administrative paper task.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 120. HACCP critical control points vs administrative planning.

cards.front: Identify the proper size of a soup plate.
cards.rationale: Standard chinaware dimensions: A soup plate (or deep rim soup bowl) is typically 9 inches in diameter. Placeplates are 12", dinner plates 10", and bread/butter plates 6".
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 121. Chinaware: Soup plate = 9 inches.

cards.front: In order to make a perfect jelly, there should be a right combination of ___.
cards.rationale: The jelly triad requires precise equilibrium: 60–65% sugar, 0.5–1.0% high-methoxyl pectin, and a pH of 3.0–3.4 (acid) to form a stable pectin-sugar-acid gel network.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 122. Jelly triad: Pectin + Acid + Sugar.

cards.front: Which is TRUE about pasteurized milk?
cards.back: Heat is applied to at least 61-65 C for at least 30 minutes
cards.rationale: Batch/vat pasteurization (LTLT - Low Temperature Long Time) heats milk to 62.8°C–65°C (145°F) for at least 30 minutes to destroy all pathogenic vegetative bacteria (such as Mycobacterium tuberculosis).
options: Milk is treated under high pressure to reduce size of fat globules
Heat is applied to at least 61-65 C for at least 30 minutes
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 123. Vat pasteurization: 61-65 C for 30 min.

cards.front: To facilitate the receiving of goods, it is desirable to locate the receiving area near the ___.
cards.rationale: The receiving area must be placed adjacent to the exterior delivery door/dock so delivery trucks can offload shipments directly with minimal cross-traffic and temperature exposure.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 124. Receiving dock placement.

cards.front: If the cost per portion of lamb shawarma with cheese is Php 20 with a 20% food cost, what would be the selling price?
cards.rationale: Selling Price = Raw Food Cost ÷ Food Cost Percentage = Php 20 ÷ 0.20 = Php 100.00.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 125. Margin calculation: 20 / 0.20 = Php 100.

cards.front: Which of the following practices in the food service business promotes care for the environment?
cards.rationale: Ecological solid waste management (segregation into biodegradable, recyclable, and residual waste) minimizes landfill contamination and promotes environmental sustainability in foodservice.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 126. Environmental sustainability in foodservice.

cards.front: Which enzyme CANNOT tenderize meat?
cards.rationale: Papain (papaya), bromelain (pineapple), and ficin (figs) are proteolytic enzymes that tenderize meat. Glucose oxidase is an enzyme used in desugaring eggs to prevent Maillard browning during drying.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 127. Plant proteases: Bromelain, Papain, Ficin. Glucose oxidase is not a protease.

cards.front: Which is responsible for the tough and fibrous inner core in carrots?
cards.rationale: Lignin is a complex non-carbohydrate polymer deposited in woody plant vascular bundles (xylem core of carrots) that does not soften significantly during cooking.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 128. Woody plant core = Lignin.

cards.front: What is an example of unethical practice?
cards.back: Favoring a supplier which provides an expensive gift to you.
cards.rationale: Accepting personal gifts or kickbacks in exchange for awarding procurement contracts is a severe breach of professional purchasing ethics and represents a direct conflict of interest.
options: Seeking approval from a director before purchasing expensive office equipment.
Favoring a supplier which provides an expensive gift to you.
Asking for a solicitation for prizes in the office Christmas party
Informing your HR on your other sources of income aside from your regular job.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 129. Purchasing ethics and anti-kickback codes.

cards.front: Thames University offers dishes in their canteen which are repeatedly offered every 30 days. From time to time, the canteen concessionaire also offers menus which are in season. Which type of menu is this?
cards.rationale: A cycle menu is a carefully planned sequence of menus repeated over a specified time interval (e.g., a 30-day or 4-week cycle).
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 130. Menu types: Cycle menu = rotated over a specific period.

cards.front: Annatto extract is added in food to enhance natural colors. This additive acts as ___.
cards.rationale: Annatto (atsuete) is a natural carotenoid-based food coloring additive containing bixin and norbixin that imparts a vibrant yellow-orange color to foods.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 131. Annatto = natural color additive.

cards.front: Dante is a purchasing officer at First Fruits company. The bidding was opened for new equipment. Supplier A provided the lowest bid. Supplier B provided a slightly higher bid but offered Dante a free trip to Hong Kong. Which supplier would Dante choose?
cards.back: Supplier A as it offers the lowest bid and Supplier B's practice is against the code of integrity.
cards.rationale: Professional purchasing integrity requires objective evaluation based on lowest responsive bid and specifications; accepting personal travel incentives violates business ethics and company procurement rules.
options: Supplier B as it offers a free trip promo.
Supplier A as it offers the lowest bid and Supplier B's practice is against the code of integrity.
Supplier B as it fosters a good relationship with the client
Get one item from Supplier A and the rest from Supplier B.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 132. Procurement ethics and anti-bribery standards.

cards.front: What is the age of meat if the color is pink?
cards.rationale: Young animal muscle (such as milk-fed veal from young calves under 3 months) contains minimal myoglobin concentration, producing a pale delicate pink meat color.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 133. Meat color and age: Pink = very young / veal.

cards.front: Select which is NOT correct about carbon footprint.
cards.back: indicates the amount of organic ingredients in the menu
cards.rationale: A carbon footprint quantifies total greenhouse gas emissions (in CO2 equivalents) generated across the life cycle of food. It does not measure or indicate organic ingredient percentages.
options: estimates the climate change impact in producing food
measures the impact on the environment
measures the amount of greenhouse gases emitted
indicates the amount of organic ingredients in the menu
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 134. Carbon footprint definition.

cards.front: A management function that involves inspecting the work that is done, ensuring the standards are met and monitoring that the work is done as planned:
cards.rationale: Controlling is the managerial process of setting performance standards, measuring ongoing performance against those standards, and taking corrective actions when deviations occur.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 135. Management functions: Controlling.

cards.front: The similarity of dressed and drawn chicken is that ___.
cards.rationale: Dressed poultry is slaughtered, bled, and defeathered (head, feet, and viscera intact). Drawn poultry is dressed poultry with the visceral organs and entrails removed. Both are defeathered.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 136. Dressed vs Drawn poultry market forms.

cards.front: What ingredient can be an extender for Chicken Adobo to have more yield?
cards.rationale: Starchy vegetables like cubed potatoes absorb adobo braising juices and bulk up dish volume cost-effectively without altering the quintessential savory-vinegar adobo profile.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 137. Recipe extenders: Potato in adobo.

cards.front: Which enzyme causes fruit to ripen?
cards.rationale: Pectinase enzymes (such as polygalacturonase and pectin methylesterase) break down insoluble protopectin into soluble pectin, softening plant cell walls during ripening.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 138. Fruit softening enzyme = Pectinase.

cards.front: Which is an example of an incomplete protein?
cards.rationale: Gelatin is derived from collagen and completely lacks tryptophan, an essential amino acid, making it an incomplete protein with low biological value.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 139. Incomplete animal protein = Gelatin (lacks Trp).

cards.front: In a conventional food service flow diagram, which is situated in the central area?
cards.rationale: The main cooking/hot production bank is typically situated at the operational center of the kitchen layout to provide shortest transit paths to receiving/prep on one side and service/plating on the other.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 140. Kitchen layout workflow: Cooking unit in center.

cards.front: Pilaf: Middle East; ___: Spain
cards.rationale: Paella is the iconic saffron-scented national rice dish of Spain. Nasi goreng is Indonesian, and Basmati is an Indian long-grain rice variety.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 141. National rice specialties: Paella = Spain.

cards.front: What is the ideal number of members when you have consumer panel test?
cards.rationale: Consumer acceptance panels require large cohorts of untrained consumers (typically 50 to 100+ panelists) to achieve statistical significance for product market acceptance.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 142. Sensory testing panels: Consumer panels require 50+ members.

cards.front: A leadership style based on the "majority rules", in which decisions are made by the group rather than a manager alone:
cards.rationale: Democratic (participative) leadership encourages employees to participate in decision-making and relies on group discussion, voting, and majority decisions.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 143. Democratic leadership.

cards.front: The following agencies are responsible in ensuring the safety of our food products EXCEPT FOR:
cards.rationale: The DA (primary agricultural food safety), DOH, and FDA (processed foods) are official regulatory agencies under RA 10611. The Commission on Population (POPCOM) handles population and family planning.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 144. Food safety regulatory bodies under RA 10611.

cards.front: India: Roti; France: ___.
cards.rationale: Roti is the traditional daily staple flatbread of India; the Baguette is the traditional daily staple bread of France.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 145. International staple breads.

cards.front: The minimum temperature for sterilization for a certain length of time is ___.
cards.rationale: Sterilization in food thermal processing requires achieving temperatures at least at or above 100°C (boiling point) for acid foods, or 121°C in retorts for low-acid foods.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 146. Thermal processing thresholds.

cards.front: Rona, a product formulator, would like to assess consumers' preference of five ice cream variants from "most like" to "least like". Which is the appropriate sensory evaluation method to use?
cards.rationale: A ranking test asks panelists to arrange 3 or more coded samples in ordinal sequence according to degree of liking, sweetness, or preference.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 147. Sensory evaluation: Ranking test.

cards.front: Green tea, grapes and wine are high in phytonutrients called ___.
cards.rationale: Polyphenols (including epigallocatechin gallate in green tea, and resveratrol and anthocyanins in grapes and red wine) are potent antioxidant phytochemicals.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 148. Polyphenols in tea, grapes, and wine.

cards.front: How many teaspoons are there in 1 tablespoon?
cards.rationale: Standard culinary and pharmaceutical liquid measure: 1 tablespoon = 3 teaspoons = 15 mL = 1/2 fluid ounce.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 149. Kitchen conversions: 1 tbsp = 3 tsp.

cards.front: Krizzia is counselling Ralstein, an obese patient depressed about body image wanting major lifestyle changes. Krizzia's initial objective in the interviewing process should be to:
cards.back: Establish rapport with Ralstein by getting to know her better before discussing anything
cards.rationale: Establishing initial trust, unconditional positive regard, and emotional rapport is the essential first phase of therapeutic nutrition counselling before gathering technical diet recalls.

Determine the 24-hr food recall and anthropometric measurements
Establish rapport with Ralstein by getting to know her better before discussing anything
Determine food preferences and current medications Ralstein is taking in.
cards.userNotes: PRC NDLE Oct 2021 Set B, Item 150. Nutrition counselling initial objective: Build rapport.

cards.front: Dante is a medical representative from a nutraceutical company who visited Krizzia in the office. Identify an UNACCEPTABLE practice:
cards.back: Krizzia is requesting Dante for a sponsorship to her mom's party
cards.rationale: Soliciting personal sponsorships, gifts, or financial benefits for family events from commercial pharmaceutical/nutraceutical representatives is a direct violation of professional healthcare ethics.
options: Dante explains the benefits of the newly launched product to Krizzia
Dante inviting Krizzia to attend a launch of their new product in a five-star hotel
Krizzia is receiving samples of nutraceuticals for distribution to her patients
Krizzia is requesting Dante for a sponsorship to her mom's party
